en.title: cr
en.summary: This is the letter L336 from the alphabet vowel-consonant groups.

sections.title: The letters cr
paragraphs: The letters cr make one consonant cluster. A consonant cluster is two or more consonants side by side with no vowel between them. You hear this sound in the word (crab) /kræb/, which means a sea creature with ten legs. This letter group has only one sound.

sections.title: How to say cr
paragraphs: First, lift the back of your tongue to touch the soft roof of your mouth. Stop the air, then release it in a quick burst. Next, pull the tip of your tongue slightly back and curl it up without touching the roof. Let the voice vibrate as the air flows smoothly. Place your hand on your throat to feel the voice turn on.

sections.title: Spelling and sounds
paragraphs: The letters cr appear at the start of words or before a vowel. You hear this pattern in (crab) /kræb/ and in (cross) /krɒs/. The sound stays identical in every word.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not tap or roll your tongue when you say the second part. Many speakers let the tongue touch the ridge behind the teeth. Keep the tongue tip curled back and completely free from touching the mouth roof. Smooth the two sounds together without adding an extra vowel sound between them.
